description: Special Programme for Coconut Land Rehabilitation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to provide a supply to meet the demand for coconut in the country and to protect coconut cultivation from the 'El Nino' ​​condition predicted to occur in the coming months, the need to increase the productivity of coconut lands and promote sustainable cultivation methods has been identified. For the purpose, a special programme for coconut land rehabilitation has been planned to be implemented with the aim of encouraging smallholder coconut growers. Under the programme, it is expected to cover about 85,000 acres of coconut land in 2026 and to implement the programme for a period of 03 consecutive years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to provide subsidies to smallholder coconut growers owning five acres or less of coconut land subject to a maximum of 65% of the amount spent on the following activities, was approved by the Cabinet: Serial No.ActivityMaximum amount paid01Mulching of coconut cultivation using fertilizer and DolomiteRs.700 per tree02Mulching of coconut cultivation using DolomiteRs.200 per tree03Irrigation of the coconut landRs.50,000 per acre
